entries.title: Children of Ursus
entries.note: Not necessary to understand the main plot, but provides some additional context. The events of this storyline are referenced in Episode 15 though so you might want to check it out.

entries.title: Operational Intelligence
entries.note: The stories "The Anonymous Ones' War", "Destroyer", and "Among the Light and the Dust" give more insight into the characters of the main theme, but aren't necessary for the overall plot.
stories: Among the Light and the Dust

entries.title: Darknights Memoir
entries.note: Reading Darknights Memoir at this point is almost necessary to understand the actions of a certain character in subsequent main story chapters as it gives a very important backstory for her.

entries.title: Roaring Flare
entries.note: Official end to the Reunion Arc.

entries.title: Preluding Lights
entries.note: The story "Crushed Earth" provides an epilogue to some members of Reunion. Other stories are unrelated.

entries.title: Dossoles Holiday
entries.note: Not directly tied into the main plot, but does resolve some character conflict from the Reunion Arc.

entries.title: Beyond Here
entries.note: Only "No Sequel" and "For a Better Self" relate to the main story. Other stories are unrelated to the main plot. Even the relevant stories aren't too important, but do have extra character moments.

entries.title: A Walk in the Dust
entries.note: Not overall too important to the main plot but does introduce some characters who will show up later.

entries.title: A Light Spark in the Darkness
entries.note: Introduces a recurring side character for the Victoria arc.

entries.title: Vigilo
entries.note: Vigilo is mainly foreshadowing a lot of things that will happen in later parts of the story, a lot of characterization and backstory for some of the core Rhodes Island members so still a fairly important read.

entries.title: Stormwatch
entries.lead: While not at all necessary, it may be helpful at this point to read the Kazimierz plotline through Near Light to learn a bit more about the Followers.

entries.title: What the Firelight Casts
entries.note: Directly related to main story events. Ties Episode 9 back into the rest of the arc. Events of this side story are directly referenced in Episode 12.

entries.title: See You Soon
entries.note: See You Soon takes place in the middle of Episode 14, providing more details about the goings on of the war.

entries.title: Ending a Grand Overture
entries.note: Concludes the character arcs of several major characters in the Victoria arc.

entries.title: When Elegies are Ashes
entries.note: Direct sequel to What the Firelight Casts, but also concludes major story threads from Episodes 9 through 14 and See You Soon.

entries.title: A Kazdelian Rescue
entries.note: Not at all necessary to understand future plotlines, this is just if you want to see what happens to Kazdel after the war.

entries.title: Sarkaz Furnaceside Fables
entries.note: Direct sequel to A Kazdelian Rescue. Only the first ending is canon.

entries.title: Babel
entries.note: Very important backstory about all the major characters of the arc needed to understand Episode 14.

entries.title: Dissociative Recombination
entries.note: The first couple of nodes finish up Arc 2 but the majority of it is the start of Arc 3.
entries.lead: The story kind of assumes from here you've already read Lone Trail and Path of Life. Of the two, Lone Trail is recommended since the more confusing parts of Episode 15 (and Episode 16 references it as well) will make much more sense if you've read it. Path of Life is skippable but nice to have.

entries.title: Abnormal Spectrum
entries.lead: Major characters from Arc 3 show up in The Masses Travel, so it might be recommended to read it before moving on to Episode 16. However, it doesn't tie into Episode 16's plot in any major way, so you can skip it and still be fine.

entries.title: Grani and the Knights' Treasure
entries.note: Introduces one of the lead characters of the storyline, as well as an important macguffin.

entries.title: Beyond Here
entries.note: Only "For a Better Self" is related to this plotline, all other stories in this collection are unrelated. Doesn't have much but does have a little extra characterization for an important character in Under Tides.

entries.title: Under Tides
entries.note: The formal introduction to the main conflict of the storyline.

entries.title: Preluding Lights
entries.note: The story "Forgotten Lighthouse" helps bridge the gap between Under Tides and Stultifera Navis. Other stories are unrelated.

entries.title: Stultifera Navis
entries.note: Direct sequel to Under Tides.

entries.title: Mizuki and Caerula Arbor
entries.note: Not directly tied into the main plot but has a lot of interesting lore. Only the first ending is canon.

entries.title: Path of Life
entries.note: Direct sequel to Stultifera Navis.
entries.lead: At this point the story assumes you've read both Lone Trail and Episode 14. Path of Life will spoil certain plot points from them (especially Lone Trail), so it might be wise to read them before continuing.

entries.title: Exodus from the Pale Sea
entries.note: Not really related to the main plot of the Seaborn plotline at all but it takes place in the same general setting so I'm including it here. It might also be relevant later on.

entries.title: Ancient Forge
entries.note: Introduces some of the relevant characters for the storyline.

entries.title: Who is Real
entries.note: Beginning of the main plot of this storyline.

entries.title: Invitation to Wine
entries.note: Direct sequel to Who is Real.

entries.title: To Be Continued
entries.note: The story "Until Next Time" has some additional events that take place in between Invitation to Wine and Where the Vernal Wind Never Blows. All other stories in this collection are unrelated.

entries.title: Where Vernal Winds Will Never Blow
entries.note: Direct sequel to Invitation to Wine.

entries.title: A Death in Chunfen
entries.note: An interquel focusing on one of the side characters from Where the Vernal Winds Never Blows. A mostly self contained story with limited impact on the overall storyline.

entries.title: Here a People Sows
entries.note: Direct sequel to Where the Vernal Wind Never Blows.

entries.title: Such Is The Joy of Our Reunion
entries.note: Direct sequel to Here a People Sows.
entries.lead: At this point I recommend having read the main story through Episode 6 since a major character from Episode 6 features heavily in Such Is The Joy of Our Reunion.

entries.title: Fantasy in the Mirage
entries.note: I'm not 100% sure how this ties into the main Sui storyline, since it doesn't resolve the cliffhanger from the end of Such Is The Joy of Our Reunion, so I'm going to leave it as "required" for now, but might make it optional depending on what happens in the next main Sui event.

entries.title: Sui's Garden of Grotesqueries
entries.note: Direct sequel to Fantasy in the Mirage. All endings are canon.

entries.title: Maria Nearl
entries.note: Start of the plotline.

entries.title: Pinus Sylvestris
entries.note: Introduces many characters that will be important in Near Light.

entries.title: Near Light
entries.note: Direct sequel to Maria Nearl.

entries.title: To Be Continued
entries.note: The story "Farewell Roy" serves as a bonus epilogue to Near Light. All other stories in this collection are unrelated.

entries.title: An Obscure Wanderer
entries.note: An epilogue serving to tie up some unfinished plot threads from Near Light.

entries.title: Operational Intelligence
entries.note: The story "After-class Homework" introduces a couple of the core characters, so it might be worth a read before starting. Other stories are unrelated.

entries.title: Mansfield Break
entries.note: Serves to set up many of the main characters of the plotline.

entries.title: To Be Continued
entries.note: The story "True Story" serves as a transition to connect Mansfield Break to Dorothy's Vision. All other stories in this collection are unrelated.

entries.title: Dorothy's Vision
entries.note: Beginning of the main conflict.

entries.title: Lone Trail
entries.note: Direct sequel to Dorothy's Vision.
entries.lead: It's recommended to read Episode 7 and Episode 8 before starting Lone Trail since it continues the arc of one of the major characters from those main story episodes.

entries.title: Unrealized Realities
entries.note: Direct sequel to Lone Trail.

entries.title: Code of Brawl
entries.note: Sets up several of the characters that will be relevant to the plotline.
entries.lead: It may be helpful to read Episode 2 and Episode 3 before starting this plotline as Penguin Logistics is formally introduced there.

entries.title: To Be Continued
entries.note: The story "Wolf and Wolfpack" serves as a transition to connect Code of Brawl to Il Siracusano. All other stories in this collection are unrelated.

entries.title: Il Siracusano
entries.note: Start of the main conflict.
entries.lead: While not entirely necessary, it might be helpful to read the main theme through Episode 6 before starting Il Siracusano since the epilogue of the story directly references events from it.

entries.title: I Portatori dei Velluti
entries.note: Direct sequel to Il Siracusano.
entries.lead: Read up through Episode 8 of the main story before continuing, I Portatori dei Velluti will spoil its biggest twist.

entries.title: Code of Brawl
entries.note: Sets up several of the characters that will be relevant to the Laterano plotline.
entries.lead: It may be helpful to read Episode 2 and Episode 3 before starting this plotline as Penguin Logistics is formally introduced there.

entries.title: Guide Ahead
entries.note: Start of the Laterano plotline.

entries.title: Preluding Lights
entries.note: The story "Different" introduces the Witch King conflict. Other stories are unrelated.

entries.title: Lingering Echoes
entries.note: Start of the Leithanien plotline.

entries.title: Hortus de Escapismo
entries.note: Direct sequel to Guide Ahead.

entries.title: Zwillingstürme im Herbst
entries.note: Direct sequel to Lingering Echoes, but also contains story elements from Hortus de Escapismo.

entries.title: The Masses Travel
entries.note: Direct sequel to Hortus de Escapismo, but also contains story elements from Zwillingstürme im Herbst and Episode 15.
entries.lead: You should definitely read Episode 15 before starting The Masses Travel, it directly ties into it.

entries.title: Preluding Lights
entries.note: The story "Letter" explains how Rhodes Island got involved in Break the Ice. Other stories are unrelated.
entries.lead: I recommend reading the Kazimierz plotline before starting the Kjerag plotline due to some overlapping characters.

entries.title: Break the Ice
entries.note: The start of the plotline.

entries.title: To Be Continued
entries.note: The story "Browntail" has some additional events that take place in between Break the Ice and The Rides to Lake Silberneherze. All other stories in this collection are unrelated.

entries.title: The Rides to Lake Silberneherze
entries.note: Direct sequel to Break the Ice.
entries.lead: I recommend reading the Main Theme through Episode 12 before continuing as it's necessary to understand the central conflict of The Rides to Lake Silberneherze.

entries.title: Retracing Our Steps
entries.note: Direct sequel to The Rides to Lake Silberneherze.
entries.lead: It's recommended that you read the Rhine Lab plotline at this point as Retracing Our Steps kind of assumes you've read Lone Trail.

entries.title: Heart of Surging Flame
entries.note: Start of the plotline.

entries.title: Code of Brawl
entries.note: Not part of the overall plotline but introduces characters that will be important for So Long, Adele.

entries.title: So Long, Adele
entries.note: Direct sequel to Heart of Surging Flame.
entries.lead: At this point I recommend reading the main theme through Episode 5 in order to get introduced to a certain character that will be important in So Long, Adele.

entries.title: The Great Chief Returns
entries.note: Start of the plotline.

entries.title: Ideal City: Endless Carnival
entries.note: Direct sequel to The Great Chief Returns.

entries.title: Tales Within the Sand
entries.note: This is technically the start of the plotline where its main character is introduced…but it's honestly really light on story and all the important details are recapped in Adventure that Cannot Wait For the Sun…so it's ok if you want to just skip to that.

entries.title: Adventure that Cannot Wait For the Sun
entries.note: Start of the plotline.

entries.title: Twilight of Wolumonde
entries.note: The bulk of this plotline is here.

entries.title: Rewinding Breeze
entries.note: The story "Recollection" serves as an epilogue to Twilight in Wolumonde. The other stories are unrelated.

entries.title: Rewinding Breeze
entries.note: The story "Crisscrossing Shadows" serves as the introduction to this plotline. The other stories are unrelated.

entries.title: Phantom & Crimson Solitaire
entries.note: The first major entry in this plotline. All endings are canon.

entries.title: Act or Die
entries.note: Direct sequel to Phantom and Crimson Solitaire.

entries.title: Operational Intelligence
entries.note: The story "Polaris" introduces two of the core characters of the plotline. The other stories are unrelated.

entries.title: The Black Forest Wills a Dream
entries.note: Start to this plotline.

entries.title: Expeditioner's Jǫklumarkar
entries.note: Direct sequel to The Black Forest Wills a Dream. All endings are canon.

noteRu.The stories \"The Anonymous Ones' War\",: Истории «Война безымянных», «Разрушитель» и «Среди света и пыли» глубже раскрывают персонажей основной темы, но не являются обязательными для общего сюжета.
noteRu.Reading Darknights Memoir at this point: Прочтение «Мемуаров Тёмных рыцарей» на этом этапе почти обязательно для понимания поступков одного из персонажей в последующих главах основного сюжета, поскольку раскрывает её важную предысторию.
noteRu.The story \"Crushed Earth\" provides an: История «Раздавленная земля» служит эпилогом для некоторых членов «Воссоединения». Остальные истории не связаны с сюжетом.
noteRu.Not directly tied into the main plot, bu: Не связано напрямую с основным сюжетом, но разрешает некоторые конфликты персонажей из арки «Воссоединение».
noteRu.Only \"No Sequel\" and \"For a Better Se: Только «Без продолжения» и «Ради лучшего себя» связаны с основным сюжетом. Остальные истории не относятся к основному сюжету. Даже связанные истории не особо важны, но содержат дополнительные моменты с персонажами.
noteRu.Not overall too important to the main pl: В целом не слишком важно для основного сюжета, но знакомит с некоторыми персонажами, которые появятся позднее.
noteRu.Introduces a recurring side character fo: Представляет повторяющегося второстепенного персонажа для арки «Виктория».
noteRu.Vigilo is mainly foreshadowing a lot of: «Вигило» в основном предсказывает многие события более поздних частей истории, а также глубоко раскрывает характеры и предысторию ключевых членов «Острова Родос», так что читать его всё же стоит.
noteRu.Directly related to main story events. T: Непосредственно связано с событиями основного сюжета. Соединяет 9-й эпизод с остальной частью арки. События этой побочной истории прямо упоминаются в 12-м эпизоде.

noteRu.See You Soon takes place in the middle o: «До скорой встречи» происходит в середине 14-го эпизода и предоставляет дополнительные подробности о ходе войны.
noteRu.Concludes the character arcs of several: Завершает сюжетные линии нескольких ключевых персонажей арки «Виктория».

noteRu.Not at all necessary to understand futur: Совершенно не обязательно для понимания будущих сюжетных линий — только если хотите узнать, что происходит с Каздель после войны.

noteRu.The formal introduction to the main conf: Официальное введение в главный конфликт сюжетной линии.
noteRu.The story \"Forgotten Lighthouse\" helps: История «Забытый маяк» помогает заполнить пробел между «Под приливами» и Stultifera Navis. Остальные истории не связаны с сюжетом.

noteRu.Serves to set up many of the main charac: Знакомит со многими главными персонажами сюжетной линии.

noteRu.Sets up several of the characters that w: Знакомит с несколькими персонажами, которые будут важны для сюжетной линии.
noteRu.The story \"Wolf and Wolfpack\" serves a: История «Волк и стая» служит переходом между «Кодексом потасовки» и Il Siracusano. Все остальные истории в этом сборнике не связаны.

noteRu.The story \"Letter\" explains how Rhodes: История «Письмо» объясняет, как «Остров Родос» оказался вовлечён во «Взламывая лёд». Остальные истории не связаны.
noteRu.The story \"Browntail\" has some additio: История «Бурохвост» содержит дополнительные события, происходящие между «Взламывая лёд» и «Поездками к озеру Зильбернехерзе». Все остальные истории в этом сборнике не связаны.

noteRu.The story kind of assumes from here you': Начиная отсюда, история как бы предполагает, что вы уже прочитали Lone Trail и Path of Life. Из этих двух рекомендуется Lone Trail, поскольку самые запутанные части 15-го эпизода (а 16-й эпизод также ссылается на него) станут гораздо понятнее, если вы его прочитали. Path of Life можно пропустить, но он не помешает.
noteRu.Major characters from Arc 3 show up in T: Ключевые персонажи Арки 3 появляются в The Masses Travel, поэтому, возможно, стоит прочитать её перед переходом к 16-му эпизоду. Впрочем, она существенно не связана с сюжетом 16-го эпизода, так что её можно и пропустить без проблем.
noteRu.At this point the story assumes you've r: На этом этапе история предполагает, что вы прочитали и Lone Trail, и 14-й эпизод. Path of Life раскроет некоторые сюжетные повороты из них (особенно из Lone Trail), поэтому, возможно, стоит прочитать их перед продолжением.
noteRu.At this point I recommend having read th: На этом этапе я рекомендую прочитать основной сюжет вплоть до 6-го эпизода, поскольку один из ключевых персонажей 6-го эпизода играет важную роль в Such Is The Joy of Our Reunion.
